banner: GATE RESULT ONLY, presence and order, not evidence of quality.

frends:draft-reviewer.reissue: Your verdict must carry the headings `## Findings: <axis>` and `## Not verified`, each on its own line, and end with the line `Count: N findings, worst: ...`. Re-issue the verdict in that shape from what you already read; do not re-read the draft.

frends:process-builder.reissue: Your report must carry the headings `## Built`, `## Last validation` and `## Remaining`, each on its own line, and end with the line `validate_process: draft <id> · <n> errors · after last change: yes|no`. Re-issue the report in that shape from what you already did; do not change the draft.
